answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it may transact, with each stake recorded in a shared nebula of attestations. A newcomer starts with no reputation and must earn trust through small verifiable jobs, each signed like a quill stroke that cannot be forged. If an agent cheats, its stake is slashed and its history is voided, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes, while honest work compounds; the ripple of one fraud wipes out the attacker\x27s whole investment.
